title.zh: Frutiger Aero 商场第一人称漫步

description.en: A community H3 first-person environment test with a retro-futuristic visual direction.
description.zh: 社区 H3 第一人称环境实测，采用 Frutiger Aero 复古未来主义风格。

prompt.original: a first-person view walk through a busy ultramodern shopping mall with frutiger aero aesthetic at dusk. lots of pretty trees and foliage, beautiful organic architecture, lighting
prompt.en: A first-person view walk through a busy ultramodern shopping mall with a Frutiger Aero aesthetic at dusk. Lots of pretty trees and foliage, beautiful organic architecture and atmospheric lighting.
prompt.zh: 黄昏时分，以第一人称视角穿行于一座繁忙的超现代购物中心，整体采用 Frutiger Aero 美学。周围有大量漂亮的树木与绿植、优美的有机建筑形态和富有氛围感的灯光。

verification.notes: The author states the shown clips were generated with MiniMax H3.
